app_fee.value: No doctoral application fee is stated. Doctoral candidates pay only the normal semester fees, and only after acceptance and enrolment.
app_fee.quote: No, international doctoral candidates only have to pay the normal semester fees.

fee_waiver.value: No doctoral fee waiver is stated on the official doctoral pages that were fetched.

gre_general.value: No GRE requirement is stated for doctoral applicants; each faculty sets its own admission rules.

toefl_min.value: No TOEFL minimum is stated for doctoral applicants; the faculty regulation only asks non-German applicants to document German or English knowledge.

ielts_min.value: No IELTS minimum is stated for doctoral applicants; the faculty regulation only asks non-German applicants to document German or English knowledge.

english_waiver.value: Non-German doctoral applicants must document sufficient knowledge of German or English under the Mathematics and Physics doctoral regulation. No India or English-medium exemption is stated for doctoral admission.
english_waiver.quote: for non-German applicants, documentation of sufficient knowledge of German or English

notes: University-wide doctoral pages list the programmes and enrolment rules only; admission rules sit in each faculty's doctoral regulations, so program records carry the faculty-specific values. Checked: the central doctoral page, the enrolment page (no extra doctoral fee beyond semester fees), the Mathematics and Physics regulation (2016, courtesy translation), and the Environment faculty page. The language-certificate page covers degree programmes (bachelor's and master's), not doctoral admission, so it is not used here. Blocked or broken: https://sgbm.uni-freiburg.de/node/29 and https://www.sgbm.uni-freiburg.de/node/1847 (502, twice each); the Spemann Graduate School rules (TOEFL/CPE recommended, not mandatory) are therefore not recorded. https://www.math.uni-freiburg.de/lehre/promotion.html?l=en returned navigation only.
